messages.text: Anderson in talks with Surrey after Lancashire release

metadata.summary: James Anderson is in talks to join Surrey next season and extend his career in county cricket.
metadata.content: James Anderson in talks with Surrey for 2027 County Championship season after release from boyhood club Lancashire | Cricket News | Sky Sports Skip to main content James Anderson in talks with Surrey for 2027 County Championship season after release from boyhood club Lancashire Sky Sports News understands James Anderson is in talks with Surrey to extend his country cricket career; Anderson was released by Lancashire after last season, despite taking 50 wickets and serving as captain Thursday 5 November 2026 23:31, UK Image: James Anderson is in talks with Surrey James Anderson is in talks to join Surrey next season and extend his career in county cricket. Anderson, 44, was released by boyhood club Lancashire in October after over 25 years of service, a decision he said left him "sad" and "quite shocked" and made him question if there was something "fundamentally wrong with me as a person". England's all-time leading wicket-taker told his BBC podcast Tailenders last month that he had not decided whether to pursue a deal elsewhere, but Sky Sports News understands he is in negotiations with Surrey and could play at The Kia Oval, a venue where he claimed 50 wickets in 16 Tests between 2003 and 2023. metadata.content: Lewis Hamilton: Ferrari driver says team-mate Charles Leclerc races him harder than other F1 rivals | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Lewis Hamilton: Ferrari driver says team-mate Charles Leclerc races him harder than other F1 rivals Lewis Hamilton says Ferrari's drivers "will have a sit down" with team boss Frederic Vasseur after the incident that cost them a likely victory in Mexico; watch Friday's practice sessions from the Sao Paulo Grand Prix at 3.30pm and 7pm live on Sky Sports F1 Thursday 5 November 2026 23:10, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Lewis Hamilton says his only focus is competing for the world title next season with Ferrari Lewis Hamilton believes Ferrari team-mate Charles Leclerc races against him harder than he does other drivers on the Formula 1 grid. Hamilton and Leclerc's clash on the opening lap of last Sunday's Mexico City Grand Prix cost Ferrari a likely victory, and potential one-two, with Max Verstappen instead ultimately profiting to claim victory for Red Bull. Speaking after the race, Hamilton said the team needed "serious talks" to discuss the way forward to avoid a repeat in future, while also calling Leclerc's approach to such battles into question . Benn revealed to Sky Sports that he had been offered a December bout with Pacquiao. But after the rigours of making welterweight and suffering a stoppage loss to Ryan Garcia in Las Vegas in September, he wasn't able to box Pacquiao next month. He hopes though to restart talks to have the fight with Pacquiao in the first quarter of 2027. "He's an all-time legend. metadata.content: Kimi Antonelli: New F1 world champion reveals details of title celebrations and special messages received from fellow sports stars | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Exclusive Kimi Antonelli: New F1 world champion reveals details of title celebrations and special messages received from fellow sports stars Kimi Antonelli became Formula 1's youngest-ever world champion as he sealed the title in Mexico on Sunday; the 20-year-old has been congratulated by many sports stars; watch Friday's practice sessions from the Sao Paulo Grand Prix at 3.30pm and 7pm live on Sky Sports F1 Thursday 5 November 2026 18:32, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Kimi Antonelli wore a GoPro during his celebrations at the Mexico City Grand Prix Kimi Antonelli has revealed details of his celebrations after being crowned Formula 1 world champion, along with some of the messages he received in the aftermath of his historic triumph. The 20-year-old Italian finished third in Sunday's Mexico City Grand Prix to become the sport's youngest-ever drivers' title winner, achieving the feat with four rounds of the 2026 season still remaining. Despite having the final leg of a triple-header to come this weekend with the Sao Paulo Grand Prix in Brazil, a party was held on Sunday night in Mexico at which Antonelli said he did not hold back.
